page_title: CAD 0-0 BIL | Cadiz CF v Athletic Bilbao 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is cleared to safety by the defence.

90+4' A cross from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
87' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball has crossed the sideline. Cadiz CF are taking a throw-in.
86' The referee allows time for a substitution. Chris Ramos will be replaced by Alex Fernandez (Cadiz).
84' The game is pretty dull as Cadiz CF are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
80' Problems for Mauricio Pellegrino as Robert Navarro (Cadiz) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Brian Ocampo replaces him.
78' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
78' Cadiz CF work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
78' The attendance is 18839.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
77' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.
73' Mauricio Pellegrino decides to make a substitution. Ruben Sobrino will be replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
73' Fali (Cadiz) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
70' A substitution has been made. Asier Villalibre goes off and Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
67' A rebound falls kindly for Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
65' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
65' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.
63' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
62' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor is forced to make a change. Adu Ares is unable to continue due to injury, Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
60' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
59' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' Foul! Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
54' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Ath Bilbao.
51' Substitution. Mikel Vesga makes his way off the pitch and Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) comes on as his replacement.
51' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Unai Gomez is replaced by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao).
51' Substitution. Inigo Lekue did his best and is replaced by Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao).

49' Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
49' Ath Bilbao force their opponents to concede a corner.
47' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.
46' The whistle blows and Mateo Busquets Ferrer starts the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets Ferrer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
38' The corner is swung in but Cadiz CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

37' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Unai Simon pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Cadiz CF have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

32' That was close by Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.

31' A precise cross aimed towards the penalty spot was met by Ivan Alejo (Cadiz). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.

29' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
29' Cadiz CF take a short corner kick.
29' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Cadiz CF win a corner kick.
28' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
27' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
24' Cadiz CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

23' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Unai Simon to dive and make a save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cadiz CF.
23' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
20' The ball is cleared after Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
19' Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
17' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.
14' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
13' Conan Ledesma leaps to intercept the corner kick from Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).

11' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball flies way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
9' Ath Bilbao are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
7' A corner kick by Cadiz CF is thwarted by the well prepared Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao).
6' Cadiz CF have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Cadiz CF are awarded a corner kick.
6' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Cadiz CF will take a corner kick.
4' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

2' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cadiz CF will have the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
